earnings.title: NRG Energy Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results, Reaffirms 2026 Financial Guidance, and Initiates 2027 Guidance
highlights: (NYSE: NRG) today announced financial results for the third quarter ending September 30, 2026, and reports GAAP Net Income of $561 million, GAAP Earnings per Share (EPS) — basic of $2.59, and GAAP Cash Provided by Operating Activities of $1,097 million.

The Company's non-GAAP metrics are Adjusted Net Income of $983 million, Adjusted EPS of $4.68, Adjusted EBITDA of $2,013 million, and Free Cash Flow before Growth Investments (FCFbG) of $1,242 million for the third quarter of 2026.
NRG reported GAAP Net Income of $561 million for the third quarter of 2026, an increase of $409 million from the prior year.

Adjusted Net Income for the third quarter 2026 is $983 million, $446 million higher than prior year, primarily driven by an $808 million increase in Adjusted EBITDA, the impacts of which are described in the segment results below.
outlook: Expected proceeds from the announced 4.9 GW asset sale will be used to support NRG's 2027 pro forma capital allocation plan of $3 billion of share repurchases across 2026 and 2027, including an incremental $1 billion expected to begin before the end of the fourth quarter of 2026.
